title: Capability-Stratified Degradation in Ternary Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2608.28809v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Extreme low-bit inference offers a route toward smaller models and constrained deployment. Ternary language models restrict weights to $\{-1,0,+1\}$, approaching the limit of $\log_2 3 \approx 1.585$ bits/weight. The practical question for a pretrained model is not simply whether weights can be quantised but which capabilities survive and whether it remains useful for adaptation. We explore this by converting Qwen3.5-0.8B (752M parameters) to ternary weights using 72.4M tokens of quantisation-aware training (QAT). The resulting model, Cloe, is evaluated across 29 benchmarks, representation diagnostics, and downstream fine-tuning. The evidence shows non-uniform degradation. A linear probe recovers 43.76% of MMLU answers from the full-precision teacher's representations but only 26.19% from Cloe (near chance), indicating specialist factual information is lost. translated_title: 三元语言模型中的能力分层退化
translated_abstract: 极端低比特推理为更小规模的模型和受限环境下的部署提供了一条途径。三元语言模型将权重限制在 {-1, 0, +1}，逼近每权重 log₂3 ≈ 1.585 比特的理论极限。对于预训练模型而言，实际问题并不仅仅是权重能否被量化，而是哪些能力得以保留，以及模型是否仍可用于后续适配。我们通过使用 7240 万 token 的量化感知训练（QAT），将 Qwen3.5-0.8B（7.52 亿参数）转换为三元权重来探索这一问题。所得模型 Cloe 在 29 个基准测试、表征诊断以及下游微调中接受了评估。证据表明退化是非均匀的：线性探针能从全精度教师模型的表征中恢复 43.76% 的 MMLU 答案，但从 Cloe 中仅能恢复 26.19%（接近随机水平），说明专业领域的事实性信息已经丢失。然而，Cloe 在十个任务上仍保持了可测量的性能，平均达到教师模型的 77.1%……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该研究通过量化感知训练将 Qwen3.5-0.8B 转换为三元权重模型 Cloe，发现低比特量化导致能力分层退化：专业事实知识几乎完全丢失，但部分任务仍保留约 77% 的教师模型性能。
en_tdlr: Converting Qwen3.5-0.8B to ternary weights via quantisation-aware training reveals capability-stratified degradation: specialist factual knowledge is nearly lost, yet the model retains about 77% of the teacher's performance on some tasks.
